I deployed 3 AI employees in 90 minutes last Tuesday.

Total cost: $4 a day.
Total time saved: 14 hours a week.
Total replaced: a $4,000/month VA who quit twice in 2025.

Here's the exact build order:

1. Marketing AI. Reads my Soul file, drafts LinkedIn posts in my voice. Ships 5 a week.

2. Sales AI. Watches my CRM, sends cold outreach in plain English. Booked 7 calls this week.

3. Operations AI. Lands a Tuesday morning brief in my inbox before coffee. Tells me the 3 things to focus on. I do them. Done by lunch.

I am not technical. I did not write code. I did not hire a developer.

I deployed agents. That is the whole shift.

Save this if you are still doing the work yourself.

P.S. The 90 minutes includes a coffee break.
